name: zinterp_context_get_current_command
description: zInterp_Context::GetCurrentCommand returns tokenList[0] when any token is present.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c5510 validates returning tokenList[0] at context offset 0x20 when tokenCount at offset 0x08 is nonzero and returning null otherwise.
The native smoke verifies both first-token and empty-token behavior.
